$comment: Official hosts that are not .gov/.us/.mil: cities, counties and the agencies or associations that publish their taxes. A URL cited in data/ on one of these hosts is watched like any .gov page. Law-firm blogs, payroll vendors, news sites, legal-code aggregators (Justia, FindLaw) and web.archive.org copies are deliberately not here: they are not the source of a rate. Add a host only when the page is the government's own or its tax collector's.

hosts.almonline.org: Alabama League of Municipalities: the municipalities' own association; publishes their occupational tax survey
hosts.revds.com: Neumo/Revenue Discovery Systems: collects occupational tax for many Alabama cities; hosts their official return forms
hosts.birminghamal.hdlgov.com: City of Birmingham, AL: document host for the city's tax forms
hosts.gadsdenida.org: Gadsden-Etowah Industrial Development Authority: public body publishing Gadsden's taxes and fees
hosts.wilmdebudget.org: City of Wilmington, DE: budget office (publishes the city's tax rates)
hosts.kaco.org: Kentucky Association of Counties: the counties' own association; publishes the county occupational tax data brief
hosts.codelibrary.amlegal.com: American Legal Publishing: hosts cities' and counties' official codes of ordinances
hosts.library.municode.com: Municode: hosts cities' and counties' official codes of ordinances
hosts.lyndonky.munirevs.com: City of Lyndon, KY: occupational tax FAQ on its revenue-collection site
hosts.files.smartsites.parentsquare.com: Municipal document host (a Kentucky city's occupational tax ordinance)
hosts.cms2files.revize.com: Municipal document host (City of Hopkinsville, KY forms)
hosts.ritaohio.com: Regional Income Tax Agency: collects municipal income tax for hundreds of Ohio municipalities
